scope: Local small fixtures only. No server access, full/active trace scan, compiler, GPU work, production changes, or commits.
interpretation: Host API timing can overlap across workers and nesting; no CUDA kernel, wall-clock fraction, progress, remaining-time or run-completion claim.

checks.case: single-pass input SHA256, byte count and stable metadata
independent explicit timing oracle across event/op groups and ranks
marker zero and blank durations count as rows but never timing samples
zero duration on a measured API remains a valid timing sample
wrong header rejected with no partial summary
short row rejected with no partial summary
negative duration rejected with no partial summary
missing id rejected with no partial summary
invalid consumer ordinal rejected with no partial summary
empty op rejected with no partial summary
malformed CSV rejected with no partial summary
genuine during-read append detected; no summary returned
genuine during-read same_size_write detected; no summary returned
genuine during-read path_replacement detected; no summary returned
header and marker zero placeholders checked against actual runtime writer
trace path is mandatory; no implicit trace discovery
